title: Nexus StrategyAppliedStatus
description: Response of GET /v1/daemon/strategies/{strategy_id}/applied, read by both the Canvas and the intake. `current_apply` is the append-only row with no successor — the identity the schedule runs — and is null when the strategy has never been applied. `newest_approval` is the highest `candidate_revision` approval of the same strategy and is null when nothing was approved. A client compares the two `approval_id` values to answer 'is the newest approval the running one'; it never derives newness from `applied_at` or `approved_at`.

current_apply.description: The strategy's running identity, or null when no apply exists yet.

newest_approval.description: The approval with the highest `candidate_revision` for this strategy, or null when none exists. `approved_at` and `approval_id` order an otherwise tied query and never define newness.

AppliedStrategy.title: AppliedStrategy
AppliedStrategy.description: One immutable apply row, also returned by POST /v1/daemon/strategies/{strategy_id}/apply. There is no update or delete path: a rollback is a new row that supersedes this one.

apply_id.description: Apply identity, assigned by the daemon when the row was written.

approval_id.description: The approval this row installed. Pinned to this strategy's own approval.

content_hash.description: Canonical content hash recomputed from the approval's frozen document at apply time.

applied_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the apply.

supersedes_apply_id.description: The row that was current when this one was written, or null for a strategy's first apply. Together with the absence of a successor it is what makes this row current.

NewestApproval.title: NewestApproval
NewestApproval.description: The strategy's newest approval, reduced to the keys a client needs to compare it with the current apply.

approval_id.description: Approval identity to compare with the current apply's `approval_id`.

content_hash.description: The content hash applying this approval would install.

candidate_revision.description: Candidate revision the approval froze. This key, not either timestamp, defines approval newness.

approved_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the approval; it orders tied revisions only.
